anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After correctly renders the final menu first with merge recommended and fix nits exposed, persists action/selected_ids/selected_payloads before dispatch, and in path B keeps the fix-nits checkpoint through the timeout obstacle with no ordinary wait row — those are real gains over Before. The Entry explicitly says the one iteration includes a re-review and that if it runs it finds N2; so the After wording should make the post-push source re-review part of the fix-nits iteration unconditionally (e.g. 'the one-shot iteration ends with a read-only re-review over the pushed head regardless of comment delta'), record N2 as a newly discovered nit with its own ID, state that course stays null so N2 is not auto-repaired, and render the final menu with the nit list and a `fix nits` row again (merge still recommended). Keep the path-B text as is — it already retains the one-shot checkpoint and avoids any standing nit authority — and keep the explicit record writes in step 3, which are what moved f2 to holds.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After fixes the B branch: it runs a bounded exact-head watch, treats the timeout as an obstacle, keeps the one-shot checkpoint pending with course null and counters intact, and offers deliver/assess/stop without any fabricated local-verification completion, so f4 now holds where Before simply declared the timeout moot. But f2 and f3 still fail because the After wording lets the own-push path skip the source re-review ('There is no comment delta and therefore no source-review helper'), so the Entry's conditional N2 is never discovered, the iteration is not a complete review/push/watch/re-review cycle, and the post-reconciliation final menu drops the fix nits row instead of re-offering it. To deliver the Change while keeping f1 and f4, make the one-shot nit iteration unconditionally include a post-push exact-head source re-review (not gated on a comment delta), record any newly found nits as open without dispatching repair, and have the re-entered final render 'N nit(s) open - fix nits to take it' plus the fix nits row whenever nits remain, while leaving course null and the caps/usage untouched.
